note: Quests the game removed that the sheets do not mark (no placeholder issuer 1034221, no hidden flag), or mark while still giving them a journal genre. JournalRefiler treats them as retired: never counted, shown only under Removed from the game. Keys are Quest sheet row ids; patch is the patch that removed the quest, shown in the detail pane. Every entry needs a note and an evidence URL.
